title: Taiwanese American Foundation of San Diego 聖地牙哥台美基金會
content_html: The Taiwanese American Foundation of San Diego (TAFSD) is a nonprofit, public, and charitable organization incorporated in the State of California, founded in 1996 through the dedication of the Taiwanese American community in San Diego. TAFSD engages in charitable, educational, and community activities that promote Taiwanese American culture and tradition in a diverse society. It promotes the health and social well-being of community members and provides assistance to immigrants and newcomers. The Taiwanese American Community Center (TACC) is an operational unit of TAFSD, located at a permanent 13,000 sq. ft. facility housing an auditorium with 400-person capacity and a library with more than 10,000 volumes.
